plugins.name: document-writer
plugins.description: Compositional document writer for research papers, patent applications (with USPTO XML output), technical reports, grant proposals, and literature reviews. Documents live as a JSON DSL; document.md and refs.bib are always kept in sync. Domain specialists (Source / Outline / Draft / Cite / Vision Analyst / Figure / Claim / Style / Reviewer, plus patent-only Prior Art and Claim Author) each own a slice of the DSL. Every claim traces to a source; compile refuses to emit final targets while unverified claims exist. Compile to md / tex / pdf / docx / uspto_xml. Watermark support (DRAFT / CONFIDENTIAL / auto-DRAFT when unverified claims exist) renders across every target. Zero-credential local providers for PDF text extract and reference lookup; upgrade paths for Mistral OCR and Crossref.
plugins.author: BahulamAI
